s01.prompt: A realistic, gentle handheld shot in a busy daycare classroom. The teary little girl in the foreground sniffles, then slowly lifts her eyes toward the tablet the kind teacher holds up for her; her face softens and a small hopeful smile starts through her tears. The teacher smiles warmly and nods. Other toddlers keep playing softly in the background. The tablet stays steady, facing the girl, its screen a flat uniform bright green the whole time. Natural, subtle, lifelike motion, soft daylight.
